To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the RPCs are very sensitive to the neutrons in the LHC environment and that the neutron background can be reduced using a neutron shield made of polyethylene.

(1) the RPC response to neutrons has to be taken into account in order to properly interpret the RPC signals, especially in a high background environment; (2) the RPC response is energy-dependent, and the response to thermal neutrons is negligible; (3) the RPC response depends on the neutron energy spectrum; and (4) in a high background neutron environment the RPCs can be operated with a higher voltage in order to reduce the rate of spurious signals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the response of RPCs in the presence of neutrons.
the study of a Resistive Plate Chamber (RPC) response to neutron radiation.
the development of a new generation of Resistive Plate Chambers with a high rate capability.
